notes:
Account overview:
- Mid-market ecommerce platform focused on post-purchase experiences: returns, shipment tracking, exception handling.
- Current stack: GCP-hosted microservices, in-house LLM rule-layer for routing. Interested in moving to managed inference to cut infra maintenance.
Evaluation summary:
- Primary ask: low p95 latency for chat-based return agents, streaming responses to UX, reliable tool calling for live shipment lookups and RMA issuance.
- Latency SLO target: ~<350ms p95 for token streaming in typical 16-32 token bursts; peak season must be 90th percentile within SLO when traffic is 3x baseline.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget; want hosted for quick rollout but will consider Dedicated if pricing for reserved nodes reduces unit cost by ~30%.
Security/compliance notes:
- Must support SSO/SAML for internal agents, audit logs for RMA approvals, and KMS integration for envelope encryption of customer PII. EU data residency required for ~12% of customer base.
POC/technical interactions so far:
- 2026-01-20: Intro demo (Jordan + Priya) — walked through Hosted API streaming and function calling demo. Customer liked streaming. (fireflies: ff-20260120-ll)
- 2026-02-05: SE deep-dive — latency profiling required; provided model variants and quant/latency tradeoffs. Asked for sample workload replay. (drive: /drive/LastMileLoop/rl-inference-workload.csv)
- 2026-02-18: Provided Smoke POC on Hosted (2k calls/day synthetic) — observed mean latency 120ms, p95 440ms under out-of-the-box batching. Customer flagged p95 > target. (jira: INF-3312)
- 2026-02-25: Engineering call to propose batching tweaks + KV prefix cache for recurring returns prompts; agreed to run second POC with optimized batching and streaming buffer size adjustments. (fireflies: ff-20260225-ll)
